blocks.text: The simplest form builder that works like a doc

Tally reimagines form building by making it feel like writing a document. There is no drag-and-drop canvas or complex builder interface - you simply type your questions, and Tally turns them into a beautiful, functional form. It is the kind of simplicity that makes you wonder why other tools are so complicated.

The free tier is genuinely generous - unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, and most features included. For startups watching every dollar, this means you can collect customer feedback, run surveys, process applications, and capture leads without any cost.

What sets Tally apart for automation-focused teams is its integration layer. Forms connect to Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, Slack, and most automation platforms. Every submission can trigger a workflow that routes data exactly where it needs to go.
Create forms by typing - no drag-and-drop complexity
Show or hide questions based on previous answers
Accept payments via Stripe directly in your forms
Let respondents attach files and documents
Build calculators and scoring forms with math fields
Connect to Notion, Airtable, Slack, Google Sheets, and more
Tally is our go-to recommendation for form building because of its radical simplicity and generous free tier. For most startup use cases, you never need to upgrade.
Our team can integrate Tally into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
